info.title: Microsoft Dataverse Web API
info.description: The Microsoft Dataverse (Dynamics 365) Web API, an OData v4 service at https://{org}.{region}.dynamics.com/api/data/v9.2: CRUD on every standard table's entity set, the table-definition (metadata) entity sets, every documented action and function (bound and unbound), $batch and $metadata. Each environment's own $metadata (CSDL) is the authoritative per-tenant schema (custom tables and columns appear only there). The OpenFn dynamics adaptor builds {resource}/api/data/v{apiVersion}/{entityName}[({id})] and calls POST/GET/PATCH/DELETE with OData-Version 4.0 headers.
